title: App Shot Editor compose plan
description: Input to `appshot compose|publish`. The skill writes this after pairing benefits with uploaded screenshots.

canvasWidth.description: Usually OMIT (recommended). When omitted, each screen gets its device class's canvas (phone 280×608, tablet 450×600, laptop 608×380 editor units) and the editor exports at the real App Store sizes — the layout is identical either way because every layer is sized proportionally to the canvas. Only set this (together with canvasHeight) if you have a specific reason to pin one canvas size, and only for a single-device plan: it forces ONE size across ALL screens, so a mixed-device plan would squeeze e.g. iPad screens into a phone-shaped canvas.

canvasHeight.description: See canvasWidth — usually omit; if set, set both, and only for a single-device plan.

headline.description: Short, benefit-led headline: ≈2–6 words, 2 lines max (e.g. "Hear the word. Spell it."). Rendered large and bold (~8.5% of canvas width); longer copy is auto-shrunk and looks worse.

subheadline.description: Optional short supporting line under the headline (one short sentence, ≲8 words). Rendered at ~55% of the headline size, slightly muted. Omit when the headline says it all.

subheadlineColor.description: Hex color for the subheadline. Defaults to headlineColor at 85% opacity.

layout.description: text-top (default): text above, device below bleeding off the bottom edge. text-bottom: device at the top bleeding off the TOP edge, text below it. device-bleed: text on top, an oversized device (~95% of width) bleeding heavily off the bottom — a hero look.

deviceId.description: Device frame id (e.g. iphone_16_pro, pixel_9_pro, ipad_pro_13_m4).

url.description: Asset url from the upload manifest.
